title: Where the money came from and unpaid deposits
summary: Garland jokes women supplied money, and tells how organisers of lawn parties would disappear without paying.

That's the best source. Girls, girls, who's helped me. I had a lot of fun. And when I was working, it was the same thing. When I was working, they used to mess me up when I was working.
